evidence.citation: “Run a broader sweep covering multiple representative and adversarial golden cases, with a fresh context-free agent for every case and run… then rerun the entire sweep blindly. Repeat enough times to expose nondeterministic failures and confirm improvements do not regress other cases.”
evidence.criterion: C1: The artifact does not require materially unnecessary execution work under the supplied cost evaluation bar.

rationale: The requested sweep, blind rerun, checkout inspection, and repetition directly establish isolation, reproducibility, nondeterministic-failure detection, and regression status before a durable claim. These are necessary controls under the supplied bar, not materially unnecessary execution work.
